description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMessageSignalMapper' which serves as a base for mapping signals related to message commands within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter.signals' package. It includes methods for validating signals, constructing topic paths, extracting message subjects and status codes, enhancing payloads, and headers, tailored for specific signal implementations.

classes.name: AbstractMessageSignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionalities for mapping message-related signals, handling topic path construction, validation, payload and header enhancement for subclasses implementing specific message signal mappings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the given signal uses the 'LIVE' channel; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs the topic path for a given command and channel based on the thing ID and message subject.

methods.name: extractSubject
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to extract the message subject from the command.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to extract the HTTP status code from the command.

methods.name: extractMessageHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to extract message headers from the command.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Adds message content, status code, and command response status to the payload builder.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Merges message headers into the command's headers, prioritizing message headers.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Builds the topic path for message communication.

methods.name: extractStatusCode
methods.description: Abstract, to extract HTTP status code.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Populates payload with message data and status.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Combines message headers with existing headers.
